notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001543151-26-000015). Marketplace: salesEnabled = Gross Bookings − revenue. In gross (principal) markets and Freight the fare is in both Gross Bookings and revenue and nets to zero, and driver pay is counted once, through paidOut; in agent markets driver earnings sit outside revenue and are counted once, through salesEnabled. Gross Bookings include taxes, tolls and fees and are before consumer discounts (overstates). Interest and income taxes paid are inside operating cash flow (US GAAP); the 10-K still prints both in the supplemental cash-flow disclosures, and the income-tax note gives the same 345 total by jurisdiction (US federal 12, US state and local 81, foreign 252).
